implemented: Actual POST /chat binds the existing model task to the trusted HTTP actor and session, retaining session lease, principal and context. No new model or pending store.

Expiry, revocation before/after discovery, cancelled requests and actual disconnect retire the exact wait. Owned receive watcher cancels/joins on finish without is_disconnected cancellation swallowing.
Delivery acknowledgement futures are keyed by exact prompt ID; concurrent rejection cannot cancel a FIFO neighbour.
